phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Government Debt Stock
purpose: Test whether Eurostat publishes a definitionally explicit quarterly observed series for Romania general-government consolidated gross debt that can serve as the government_debt_stock reference mode without being confused with the market-valued/non-consolidated financial-accounts balance-sheet stock or with instrument-level Accounting Spine cells.

source.concept: Quarterly general-government consolidated gross debt at nominal/face value outstanding at quarter end (Maastricht debt)

promotion_rule: The reference mode may be promoted from PARTIAL_SERIES_AVAILABLE to OBSERVED_SERIES_AVAILABLE only after an immutable successful audit artifact is retained, both MIO_NAC and PC_GDP contain all four 2025 quarters with finite observations, each requested unit has at least the minimum observation count, no network or parse error is present, and a repository assessment records the workflow run, artifact identifier and SHA-256. Promotion changes only reference-mode observability; it does not complete the Accounting Spine, alter canonical holder-by-issuer matrices, or activate any behavioural mechanism.
negative_result_rule: If the exact S13 GD series is unavailable, incomplete at the required benchmark window, or cannot be retained reproducibly, government_debt_stock remains PARTIAL_SERIES_AVAILABLE and no Financial Accounts or debt-security-only subtotal may be silently relabelled as total government debt.
